description: Audit a whole NDJSON batch against one schema in a single call. Returns the failing line number and pointer for every breach, the count of valid, invalid and unparseable lines, and the first failing line. A blank line between records is reported rather than skipped, because it is almost always a producer bug. Pay 120000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

jsonl.description: Newline-delimited JSON, one value per line, at most 262144 bytes and 2000 lines.

schema.description: A JSON Schema using the supported keyword subset: type, enum, const, required, properties, additionalProperties, patternProperties, items, prefixItems, minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems, minLength, maxLength, pattern, format, minimum, maximum, exclusiveMinimum, exclusiveMaximum, multipleOf, minProperties, maxProperties, nullable, allOf, anyOf, oneOf, not, $ref, $defs, definitions, title, description, default, examples, example, deprecated, readOnly, writeOnly. Patterns use a non-backtracking subset with no groups or alternation. $ref resolves inside the document only; a remote reference is refused rather than fetched. A keyword outside the subset is reported in not_examined rather than treated as satisfied.

stop_after_failures.description: Stop auditing once this many lines have failed, for a fast gate over a large batch. Stopping early is reported in not_examined.

name: jsonl_contract_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of the input was not analysed, which is a different problem from input that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing below is bounded.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the exact location.

findings_by_code.description: Counts per code, for triage without reading the list.

first_failing_line.description: 1-based and counting every line, so it matches a text editor.

line_count.description: Lines supplied, excluding a trailing newline.

not_examined.description: Named reasons anything was left unexamined: a bound reached, an unsupported keyword, an unresolvable reference, or findings beyond the listing cap.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

valid.description: True only when every line was audited and every line conformed.

title: JSONL Contract Audit
